Name: Orca Deck
Author: miguelpicado
Description: Keys for Orca: one per main agent (repo, colour, state; press to focus) and one per AI account quota (5h, weekly, monthly).

Actions.Name: Orca agent
Actions.Tooltip: Fills itself with the next main Orca agent. Press to focus its pane.

Actions.Name: Clock
Actions.Tooltip: HH:MM and date. Fits the side panel (Information controller).

Actions.Name: Agent summary
Actions.Tooltip: Live Orca agents: working / waiting / done. Fits the side panel (Information controller).

Actions.Name: AI quota
Actions.Tooltip: Fills itself with the next account from quota-status.json. Press to refresh.
